rule: Same meeting and same facts needed for a complete answer count as one question. Similar topics, partial fact overlap and generic request templates do not by themselves imply the same question.

same_conversation_comparisons.reason: Extracting segment start/end times differs from whether a project schedule was updated.
The three result types differ from the rule for ordering results.
An XML transformation tool differs from the person compiling written sections.
The company color differs from whether its slogan should appear on the remote.
The company instruction about teletext differs from a decision about voice recognition.
Which devices the remote controls differs from whether number buttons are essential.
What may be changed on the TV receiver differs from whether remote components are final choices.
The percentage losing remotes differs from the percentage finding a new remote hard to learn.
A survey age group’s willingness to pay for voice control differs from an agreed product audience.
The original audience alone differs from comparing original and revised audiences; the newer simple control asks only for the revised audience.
Willingness to pay for appearance differs from the fraction of buttons people use.
Group revenue-growth guidance differs from Cepheid shipment counts.
The accounting basis for Cytiva in core growth differs from where documents are available.
Results for re-imaged stores differ from comparing January sales with the full quarter.
Criteria for choosing rebranding versus re-imaging differ from completion of California conversions.
